title: Variance reduction for forces and pressure in variational Monte Carlo
summary: We present simple and practical strategies to reduce the variance of Monte Carlo estimators. Our focus is on variational Monte Carlo calculations of atomic forces and pressure in electronic systems, although we show that the underlying ideas apply more broadly to other observables, like pair-correlation and angular-distribution functions, and other methods, including molecular dynamics.
